prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the green stone terraces of Machu Picchu with stone steps of normal height and low terrace walls, empty of tourists, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.
